title: statsInfo
description: Contains statistics about each attribute. Statistics are useful to estimate attribute distribution and range. The content depends on the [field types](field.cmn.md).

totalValuesCount.description: Represents the count of the value.

min.description: Minimum attribute value for the entire layer.

max.description: Maximum attribute value for the entire layer.

minTimeStr.description: Minimum time string represented according to [time encoding](value.cmn.md). Only used for esriFieldTypeDate i3s version 1.9 or newer.

maxTimeStr.description: Maximum time string represented according to [time encoding](value.cmn.md). Only used for esriFieldTypeDate i3s version 1.9 or newer.

sum.description: Sum of the attribute values over the entire layer.

avg.description: Representing average or mean value. For example, sum/count.

mostFrequentValues.description: An array of most frequently used values within the point cloud scene layer.
